text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha! Did you really think you could 
escape me on the straight line, Point P?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Gah!? W-What's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Point P moving along a line was no match 
for me. Nothing more needs to be said.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I have plenty to say! Put yourself in my 
shoes, being woken up day after day by 
your weird sleep-talking!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Bring it on anytime! Hurry, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...What on earth has she been doing all 
this time?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
It's unfair that only my sleep-talking is 
known. I want to know Durandal's 
sleep-talking too.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Wha...!? I-I wasn't saying anything weird 
in my sleep, okay?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Come on, stop fooling around and go to 
sleep already.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
What kind of sleepy nonsense is that? I 
don't feel any motivation from you. Save 
the sleep-talking for when you're actually 
asleep.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I can't fall asleep that fast! And even 
if I do, I'm not telling you!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(...I am completely being targeted. Since 
I have no idea what sleep-talk I might 
utter, I really want to avoid falling 
asleep first...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(I'm pretty sure it just passed 23:45... 
Just a little more... If I hold out just a 
bit longer, I'll have a chance to win—)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Just. A. Dream. Just. A. Dream.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Kh! I... I will absolutely not fall 
asleep...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I will... not fall asleep...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...It's great that you're full of energy, 
but you need to consider the time and 
place... Durendal."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Heh, fastest fake-sleeping ever. That was 
perfection.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Fuji-san definitely didn't expect me to be 
awake too... Zzzzzzzzz...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Midnight, huh. Time's up. With this, I 
won't wake up until 6:00 AM.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
It seems one cannot fight against 
ingrained habits. No one alive knows what 
I say in my sleep...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal's Voice
text_block_list.text: "No one knows what I say in my sleep...!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ... Wh... What on earth is that...!?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I can't trust myself between midnight and 
6 AM, so I set up a timer recording. Good 
thinking, me.

I was looking for Durandal to have our 
meeting, but... it seems pretty lively 
over there.
choice_data_list:
I wanted to talk to you about something... 
Are you busy right now?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer-dono?! N-No, well, um...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"We were just talking about Durandal's 
hilarious sleep-talking."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-dono?! Please don't tease me so 
mu—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
She was repeatedly turning over in her 
mind what sounded like pieces of advice 
she received during training.
choice_data_list:
Training at full power even in your 
sleep... impressive as always.

Training at full power even in your 
sleep... impressive as always, huh?

All that patient coaching really paid off, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
She was repeatedly turning over in her 
mind what sounded like pieces of advice 
she received during training.
choice_data_list:
Training at full power even in your 
sleep... impressive as always.

Training at full power even in your 
sleep... impressive as always, huh?

All that patient coaching really paid off, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"...Of course! As my lord's sword, even 
within a dream is a place to train!"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's have a listen to this 
shockingly bizarre sleep-talking! Pressing 
play—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaaaahhh! No, I still can't! 
Absolutely no way!

In the end, we couldn't hear the audio, 
but knowing Durandal's unseen efforts made 
it all worthwhile.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
T-Those are... the words of my lord. I 
shall never forget what was bestowed upon 
me.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Even if it is only within a dream, I will 
not alter a single word.
choice_data_list:
I'll do my best to give you helpful 
guidance too.

I'll do my best to be a helpful mentor 
too!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...I am unworthy of such praise, but it 
braces my resolve! I will press forward 
with all my might!
